title: [SOA] Show Cc recipients on email messages
summary: Sales Order Agent email cards now display Cc recipients in a read-only field, matching Business Central's Email Viewer formatting, with special handling for mapped-contact replies and calculation failures.
key_points: Added Cc field to Email Details showing semicolon-separated recipients
Incoming messages show original inbox Cc list
Mapped outgoing replies filter Cc against To recipients and mapped contact
Blank Cc displayed when source data cannot be resolved instead of using unfiltered list
Added Email Inbox read permissions to fix license-level errors when opening agent timeline cards
quote: Sales Order Agent email cards did not show Cc recipients, so reviewers could not see everyone included in incoming and outgoing correspondence.
